acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Gel-based experiment; Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ion mode and used in data-dependent acquisition mode (DDA).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: modifications: monohydroxylated residue; iodoacetamide derivatized residue

The following setting was used: minimal peptide length 7 amino acids, trypsin specific digestion mode with maximum 2 missed cleavages, carbamidomethyl (C) as fixed modification, and oxidation (M) and acetylation (Protein N-term) as variable modifications.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Gel lanes were cut into slices, proteins were in gel digested with trypsin, peptides were desalted using C18 StageTip and analyzed by MS.
